findings.detail: All 984 question knowledgeIds are empty. Ledger questionIds also do not provide complete question-level competency linkage. SourceRefs and topic labels exist but do not replace semantic knowledge links.
240 questions use one of four broad topic-level objectives instead of a narrow competency objective. This is not an answer error; objective-level coverage cannot be certified from these labels.

16 char-ngram TF-IDF candidate pairs at cosine >=0.45 were semantically inspected; none establishes an unintended duplicate or contradictory correct answer. Arithmetic and season variants are legitimate differentiated practice.

findings.detail: Removing punctuation would merge mathematically distinct signed or decimal options. Manual inspection confirmed these three are false positives; NFKC/whitespace normalization preserving signs and decimal points finds zero duplicate options.
Hygiene question has a secondary cooking reference for measuring instruments. The primary hygiene source is present; this is coherent cross-topic support, not a mislabeled question.

metrics.nearDuplicateMethod: All 483636 pairs; sklearn TF-IDF Japanese character 2-4 grams cosine similarity; exact/NFKC/punctuation and numeric-cosmetic checks separately.

limitations: Read scripts/restaurant/check.py; did not execute it because it writes validation-report.json. Its relevant question checks were independently reproduced without repository mutations.
Near-duplicate retrieval is lexical; low-overlap paraphrases and semantic reuse below threshold can remain. This is not exhaustive certification of semantic uniqueness.
Did not re-verify all answers against official source PDFs or current legal/safety rules. No answer changes are proposed.
Objective exact-match comparison is a linkage diagnostic, not proof of semantic mismatch.
No native-speaker or domain-expert review was performed.
